subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-class secure Tailscale/MagicDNS onboarding path in the iOS first-run flow, and if so should it be rebased into the current #98868-branded onboarding shell?
rationale: The change is useful and proof-positive, but it replaces a first-run UX surface that current main already refreshed and it makes an explicit product/security choice to block raw 100.x setup in favor of MagicDNS/Tailscale Serve.

options.title: Rebase and adopt secure Tailscale path
options.body: Ask for a current-main refresh that preserves the #98868 visual/typography system while carrying the secure Tailscale/MagicDNS flow and raw-IP block forward.

options.title: Split only the auth-copy fix
options.body: Keep the password-missing/token-missing copy and tests as a smaller PR while deferring the Tailscale entry path to a separate product decision.

options.title: Close as superseded by onboarding refresh
options.body: If the merged onboarding refresh is the desired direction, close this branch and track any Tailscale-specific need in a narrower issue or PR.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt secure Tailscale path
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main refresh that preserves the #98868 visual/typography system while carrying the secure Tailscale/MagicDNS flow and raw-IP block forward.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision combines iOS onboarding product direction with the gateway TLS/Tailscale trust boundary that prior security commits shaped.
